description: Nine harder puzzles, each with five small, context-appropriate object replacements in the original watercolor style.

differences.label: The little phone
differences.description: Replace only the LEFT squirrel’s black smartphone with a slim closed charcoal-blue pocket notebook with small pale page edges and a spine, same size and pose; leave paws unchanged.

differences.label: Inside the dotted cup
differences.description: Replace only the lemon slice floating INSIDE the left dotted cup with one small sage-green mint leaf on plain amber tea; remove the entire lemon slice, including its white rind and segments, keeping the cup and rim.

differences.label: The frontmost cookie
differences.description: Replace only the frontmost round cookie on the plate with a small tan walnut half of the same size; preserve the other cookies and plate.

differences.label: The middle pond fish
differences.description: Replace only the middle orange goldfish near x980,y925 with a small floating warm-ochre fallen leaf, similar size and angle, faint leaf vein instead of an eye; preserve the surrounding ripples and other fish.

differences.label: The lower lemon
differences.description: Replace the lower yellow lemon on the plant at far left near x161,y841 with a small pale yellow pear of the same size, with a subtle narrow neck; preserve foliage and branches.

differences.label: The little lake bird
differences.description: Replace the little white duck on the lake with a small pale cream gull resting on the water, short straight pointed beak and gray folded wing, SAME size, no new contrasting marks or enlarged wings; keep ripples.

differences.label: The distant house
differences.description: Replace the tiny cream house above the smaller squirrel with a small canvas tent, pale cream walls and muted ochre triangular roof, same footprint and distant watercolor softness, no flag.

differences.label: The green shirt motif
differences.description: Replace the black block motif on the white seal’s green shirt with a simple small dark olive acorn silhouette with a faint cap line, same overall footprint and flat muted ink, NOT a shiny colorful badge.

differences.label: A koala shirt motif
differences.description: Replace ONLY the bottom central tree motif on the koala’s shirt near x1333,y696 with a small simple dark sage leaf silhouette with a short stem, same size and same ink; preserve all other tree motifs.

differences.label: The foreground flower
differences.description: Replace the white daisy flower head in the lower-left hedge near x138,y863 with a small off-white clover blossom of the same size, tiny rounded florets and existing green stem; preserve nearby foliage.

differences.label: The bottle stopper
differences.description: Replace only the blue screw cap and drinking spout on the lower-left water bottle with a small plain cork stopper in subdued blue-gray shadow, same size, retaining the unchanged bottle neck and body.

differences.label: The shorts fastening
differences.description: Replace the small tied drawstring on the squirrel’s black shorts with one tiny dull gray safety pin, same footprint and lightness, softly drawn with no highlights; keep shorts.

differences.label: The shelf planter
differences.description: Replace only the round beige ceramic plant pot on the right shelf with a small square warm-gray wooden planter box, same footprint and dull nighttime shading; preserve the ENTIRE plant and trailing vines.

differences.label: The shelf book
differences.description: Replace the narrow pale blue upright book on the right shelf near x1283,y504 with a small upright rolled towel in the same muted blue-gray, cylindrical top and faint rolled edge; preserve adjoining books.

differences.label: The tree in the wall picture
differences.description: Replace ONLY the LEFT tree silhouette inside the upper-left wall frame with a small muted blue mountain silhouette, same size and pigment; preserve the other tree and the entire frame.

rounds.title: A midnight snack
rounds.subtitle: One more banana, one more idea

differences.label: The windowsill figurine
differences.description: Replace the tiny tan animal figurine on the windowsill beside the books with a small wooden toy boat with a simple short mast, same overall size and subdued tan-brown, no bright sail or outlined icon.

differences.label: The green pencil
differences.description: Replace ONLY the green pencil in the pencil holder with a slender green-handled paintbrush, small soft brown bristles at its tip, same length and thickness; preserve holder and all other pens.

differences.label: The wall switch
differences.description: Replace the far-right rectangular wall switch with a small plain blue-gray key hook holding one dull gray key, same footprint and dark wall shading, no bright highlights.

differences.label: The front banana
differences.description: Replace only the FRONT lower-right banana on the plate near x1295,y675 with a small pale ochre croissant of similar curved silhouette and size; preserve the back banana, plate and shadows.

differences.label: The framed leaf
differences.description: Replace only the right green leaf in the wall picture above the laptop near x1023,y226 with a small sage-green feather silhouette, same size and transparent paint, faint central quill; preserve frame and other painted leaves.

rounds.title: Fresh from the oven
rounds.subtitle: A warm welcome at the Squirrekery

differences.label: The hanging bell
differences.description: Replace the small yellow hanging doorbell beside the door with a small simple brass wind chime: two short thin dull ochre tubes suspended from the same loop, same footprint and soft edges, no ribbon or bright highlights.

differences.label: The left bun topping
differences.description: Replace only the red cherry on the LEFT cream-topped bun with a tiny muted-red strawberry, same size and lightness, a very small green tip; preserve bun, icing and right cherry.

differences.label: A wooden utensil
differences.description: Replace only the LEFT wooden flat spatula inside the small white utensil cup on the right counter with a small wooden fork with three short rounded tines, same tan shade and size; preserve cup and other utensils.

differences.label: The shelf jar
differences.description: Replace the RIGHT small pale storage jar on the high shelf behind the shopkeeper near x1297,y326 with a squat little cream sugar bowl with a low lid, same dull cream-gray colors and footprint; preserve neighboring jars.

differences.label: The upper shelf roll
differences.description: Replace only the small golden bread roll on the upper shelf near x941,y315 with a small ochre pear, same size and muted shading, slight narrow neck and short stem; preserve shelf and other breads.

differences.label: The desk eraser
differences.description: Replace the blue-white eraser on the open book with a short piece of pale blue-gray chalk, same overall size, round chalk ends and a faint powdery edge; preserve the book.

differences.label: The fridge magnet
differences.description: Replace the small yellow cat-shaped fridge magnet with a small pale ochre pear-shaped magnet, same footprint and lightness, short dull green stem, no dark outline.

differences.label: The shelf ornament
differences.description: Replace the little cream bird ornament on the left shelf with a tiny pale wooden toy sailboat, same size, a small triangular cream sail and dull tan hull, no contrast boost.

differences.label: The framed flower
differences.description: Replace only the LEFT yellow flower head in the wall picture at right with a small pale yellow butterfly perched on its existing stem, same footprint; preserve the second flower, leaves and frame.

differences.label: The foreground pencil
differences.description: Replace the short green pencil lying diagonally near the lower-right open book with a short closed green fountain pen in the same position, length and thickness, a small dull metal clip instead of the exposed pencil tip; preserve papers.

rounds.title: Under the blossoms
rounds.subtitle: A familiar walk feels new again

differences.label: The suitcase pocket
differences.description: Replace ONLY the small front pocket on the gray suitcase with a small oval gray-tan leather luggage tag lying against the same area of the case, same size and low contrast, faint punched hole and narrow loop; preserve suitcase, wheels and hand.

differences.label: The distant bin
differences.description: Replace the gray-blue bin near the distant bus stop with a small gray-blue mailbox with a horizontal mail slot, same height, width, dull tone and perspective, no red paint, sign or tall pedestal.

differences.label: The drifting petal
differences.description: Replace the small pink petal floating above the shelter near x437,y307 with a small pale pink butterfly with folded open wings, same size and delicacy, no crisp dark outline.

differences.label: The hedge flower
differences.description: Replace one white daisy head in the foreground hedge near x262,y801 with a small cream clover blossom with tiny rounded florets, same size and original green stem.

differences.label: The high window
differences.description: Replace only the high LEFT blue window on the far-left distant building near x60,y48 with a closed pale blue wooden shutter with faint horizontal slats, same footprint, preserve building and all other windows.

rounds.title: A softer kind of morning
rounds.subtitle: Stretch a little. Slow down a little.

differences.label: The bottle stopper
differences.description: Replace only the blue lid on the water bottle at left with a plain small blue-gray cork stopper, same footprint, muted shading and original bottle body.

differences.label: The upper exercise weight
differences.description: Replace the small pink dumbbell at upper center with a short wooden massage roller with two small rounded ends and a ridged central cylinder, SAME overall length and thickness, muted pinkish-taupe watercolor, resting in the same direction.

differences.label: The little table cup
differences.description: Replace the dotted mug at upper right with a small low ceramic sugar bowl with a flat lid, same blue dots and cream glaze, same footprint, no spout or large decorative handle; preserve table and flowers.

differences.label: A table flower
differences.description: Replace only the topmost small white daisy head near x1635,y266 in the table vase with a small cream moth with folded upright wings perched on the same stem, smaller than the original flower head, muted pale wings, preserve all other flowers.

differences.label: The lower exercise weight
differences.description: Replace the lower-left pink dumbbell with a small loosely coiled pink jump rope, two short wooden pink handles tucked into the coil, SAME overall footprint and desaturated pink color; no large loops outside the region.

rounds.title: Better when we’re together
rounds.subtitle: Something good is always worth sharing

differences.label: The left daisy
differences.description: Replace the small white daisy head at lower left with a pale cream butterfly resting on the existing green stem, same flower-head size and lightness, faint delicate pencil edge; keep all foliage.

differences.label: The right daisy
differences.description: Replace the small white daisy head at lower right with a small off-white clover blossom, same size, tiny rounded florets and existing green stem; keep foliage.

differences.label: The chalk bread
differences.description: Replace only the small white chalk bread sketch inside the LEFT pavement board with a chalk croissant sketch of the same size, same faint rough white chalk line, no steam or writing; keep board.

differences.label: The little window
differences.description: Replace the right-hand blue window above the brown bear near x987,y237 with a closed pale blue wooden shutter with faint horizontal slats, same size and muted tone; preserve house.

differences.label: The shop bread roll
differences.description: Replace only the LEFT small golden round bread roll on the lower shop shelf near x56,y468 with a small ochre croissant, same size and soft golden watercolor, preserve adjacent bread and shelf.
